note: Both arms read one tree at one path -- the MCP arm's servers read the image's own /data in the run's container, and the mirage /data mount is a copy of it taken out of the same image. The repositories under repos/ are the clones upstream's image makes, at upstream's commits. GitHub is mirage's GitHub fake on both arms, and it holds nothing. MongoDB is the database this run restores from Atlas's dump, the same one both arms read. Airtable is the fake both arms read, seeded per run with the base Atlas shares in place of an export.
